responsibility: Implements GCC’s generic graph data-structure algorithms and storage operations declared in graphds.h. It creates and frees graph objects backed by obstacks, adds edges and merges vertices, provides textual graph dumping and edge iteration helpers, and contains the reusable nonrecursive DFS machinery used to traverse full graphs or filtered subgraphs with optional edge-skipping callbacks, compute strongly connected components, and build dominance trees via iterative immediate-dominator computation over predecessor relationships.
same_name_distinction: This is the graphds group's implementation file for the generic graph library: it allocates graph objects, mutates edges/vertices, dumps graphs textually, and implements DFS, SCC, and dominator-tree algorithms. Unlike graphds.h, which defines the graph/vertex/edge structures and declares the APIs, this file supplies the executable storage management and traversal algorithms.
